scope: Theorem 6.1 (Trajectory-overlay construction) of the manuscript “Conditional permutations in a revealed switching environment” (preprints/Conditional-permutations-in-a-revealed-switching-environment-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 59a17db01074b8bb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For n = 2d, the full-deck law from any deter- ministic start has total-variation distance tending to zero from uniform after 33030144d physical shuffles.
